games.title: Waternet
games.description: A pipe-connecting puzzle game based on the Net and Netslide puzzles from Simon Tatham's Portable Puzzle Collection. In every mode the goal is to connect all the pipes so that water can flow through them from the source. There are three game modes: Rotate, where each pipe is turned in place; Slide, where whole rows and columns are shifted using the arrows around the board; and Roslid, which combines both. Each mode has five difficulties with 25 levels each, for 375 levels in total, plus a Random difficulty that generates endless new levels. An in-game help section explains the rules of each mode.

games.title: GBHack
games.description: A roguelike dungeon crawler for the Game Boy Color inspired by NetHack. Descend 15 procedurally generated dungeon levels through permadeath, unidentified items, hunger, pets, shops, and traps to retrieve the Amulet of Yendor. Runs on original GBC hardware. Written in C with GBDK and generated with Claude Code.
